rows.en: Lodis: "...I'm sorry. I keep putting you through so much trouble."
Touya: "It's fine. How are things on your end?"
Lodis: "A few people suffered minor injuries.
Apart from that, the only damage was to part of the palace.
Tix is safe too."
Celica: "Thank goodness..."
Lodis: "He isn't feeling well at the moment,
so he's asleep in his room."
Ymir: "I'm glad you're safe.
Don't worry about us. Please make stabilizing the country
your first priority."
Lodis: "Yes. I will.
...I'd like to accompany you if I could... But that isn't possible.
Still, if you need our help, tell me anytime."
Celica: "Yes. When the time comes, I won't hesitate to ask."
Lodis: "Hey, show a little restraint.
...Well then, may the wind of hope be with you..."
Touya: "The wind of hope... Huh."
Ai: "Oh, Rishuna. Are you all right?"
Rishuna: "Yes. I'm fine now."
Valga: "But it'll be dangerous
if you keep doing that. This body hasn't been a pilot for long.
Be careful."
Rishuna: "Yes..."
Touya: "You really pushed yourself too far..."
Rishuna: "I-I'm sorry..."
Touya: "But because you were there, everyone was protected... Thanks."
Rishuna: "Yes."
Valga: "Now, what will you do next?
I'd suggest going to the place that Bernst fellow mentioned:
Alterias Valley..."
Touya: "Oh, right. He did mention that.
So where is it?"
Maki: "It's a valley northwest of here."
Fain: "Maki! Are you well enough already?"
Maki: "I can't stay in bed forever.
More importantly, he found quite a hiding place.
That's where a Sorge Field has formed, isn't it?"
Touya: "A 'Sorge Field'?"
Ymir: "We don't fully understand it,
but it's a sort of barrier. The greater something's mass,
the harder it is for it to enter that airspace."
Ai: "A barrier, huh? But why wasn't anyone watching
such an obviously suspicious place?"
Ymir: "A person might get through, but something in an Armored Mech's class
can't enter. We wouldn't think anyone could
get in there."
Kasumi: "Then the chance he's there..."
Celica: "We can't rule it out... No, it's actually quite likely.
But we can't head there right away."
Touya: "Why not?"
Celica: "We're running low on supplies for the Spirit Mechs,
and Liebhofen needs adjustments too.
So we'll stop by the Holy Land first."
Touya: "Well, it's on the way... Then let's get moving.
The sooner we get there, the better."
Ymir: "Yes. It seems the knights have returned
to the royal capital, so things should be all right there."
Ai: "All riiight! Then let's go!"
Gen: "Are you really okay?"
Vales: "Yes. Didn't I tell you this hardly counts as an injury?
I can't stay in bed forever."
Gen: "...Hey, Dad."
Vales: "Hm?"
Gen: "Why... did you leave home without us?"
Vales: "..."
Gen: "I don't mind.
But Sis says she just can't forgive you for it...
That's why I want to know."
Vales: "...What has Rosalie told you?"
Gen: "That you can only live in battle..."
Vales: "I see..."
Gen: "That's not true, right? You wouldn't abandon us
just for something like that..."
Vales: "Gen... I'm sorry, but it's true.
There were other things too, but that was the direct reason."
Gen: "Other things...? What were they?"
Vales: "...It's a dull story. An ordinary power struggle.
Back then, Revios and I were competing for the highest military post.
We were caught up in the rivalry,
along with those ridiculous factions.
I didn't care about rank.
But the people around me didn't see it that way.
Geel, the leading figure in Revios's faction,
led an attempt to bring me down. When that failed,
they began making veiled threats. Against my family."
Gen: "You mean Mom and Sis?"
Vales: "Yes. Frankly, I was sick of it.
So I stepped aside on the condition
that they leave my family alone.
But I suppose that still wasn't enough to reassure them.
Afterward, they kept finding excuses to interfere.
...I threw everything away.
I did the worst thing a warrior, a knight could do.
And a father, too. I fled the country.
I sank to the lowest of the low..."
Gen: "Why would you do that...?
You should've just beaten those bastards!"
Vales: "...I'm sorry... That was the only way
I could protect you... But even after I became a mercenary,
I never once forgot about you.
Please believe that, at least..."
Gen: "Who's there? Don't tell me..."
Gen: "...Sis..."
Lodis: "Rain..."
Lodis: "..."
Tix: "...N-no... Guh..."
Lodis: "Tix... So Cain's binding still..."
Lodis: "Will you kill me with that sword?
...It's true my role is over now.
After this, Tix, your era begins..."
Lodis: "If that's what you wish, I'll gladly give you my life.
But you're under a binding now. You haven't thought this through
and decided it for yourself..."
Tix: "...Guh."
Lodis: "Tix... Are you really such a weak man?
Come on, Tix..."
Tix: "Aaaaaah!"
Lodis: "..."
Tix: "B-Brother..."
Lodis: "...You did well, Tix.
That's what makes you the rightful heir."
Tix: "Brother... You're bleeding..."
Lodis: "Don't worry. It only grazed me..."
Lodis: "It's all right. You've overcome
Cain's binding. There's nothing to worry about anymore..."
Tix: "Ugh... Sob..."
Debish: "Bernst... He's becoming a nuisance..."
Sharl: "Shall I dispose of him?"
Debish: "No. Our first priority is
getting Rayblade's 'Core.'
Without it, the burden will be considerable. We'd better hurry..."
Sharl: "..."
Debish: "We have no time left.
Humanity has no future in such frail bodies.
We must evolve as living beings."
Sharl: "'We'...?"
Debish: "What's wrong? Is there something you want to say?"
Sharl: "...No. It's just that I couldn't believe
you were truly concerned for humanity."
Debish: "..."
Sharl: "I'm not criticizing you.
It seems to me your objective lies elsewhere."
Debish: "How interesting.
What do you think that objective is?"
Sharl: "...The outcome when Vorlia activates.
Isn't that what you're after?"
Debish: "I believe I am seriously concerned for the world."
Sharl: "Why do you keep secrets from me?
Do you distrust me that much? Or is it because
my father is no longer inside you?"
Debish: "...What are you saying?
I am your father, Bafred Debish..."
Sharl: "I've 'watched' you for over twenty years.
To me, a person's appearance means nothing.
You... are not my father."
Debish: "..."
Sharl: "..."
Debish: "...When did you realize?"
Sharl: "From the day my father first boarded Goderius."
Debish: "From the start, then.
Why ask me now?"
Sharl: "A whim... Isn't that enough?"
Debish: "...A whim...?"
Sharl: "Yes. A whim."
Debish: "Heh..."

review_batches.context: Entire 172-row member read after s_025/s_026. Palace damage report, Rishuna barrier-strain aftermath, Alterias/Sorge discussion and Holy Land detour; Vales family-departure explanation starts.
review_batches.decisions: Keep minor injuries/partial palace damage and Tix safe report, body recently became pilot rather than alien recently born, mass versus size barrier, unknown mechanism and no exact threshold. Supply repairs before valley, not abandoning destination. Family account is Vales's explanation, not a clean exoneration.
